control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - electrical exposure at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-3100 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 28 September 2011 a hazard report was recorded on SG-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
